linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI agent just shipped another flowchart.

It's clean. It's readable. And it looks absolutely nothing like your brand.

You have three choices: spend 30 minutes fighting with Figma, skip the diagram entirely, or ship the generic rounded-box thing and pretend you don't care.

Diagram Design fixes this in 60 seconds:

✅ Point it at your website — it extracts your exact colors, fonts, and accent palette
✅ 28 editorial diagram types (architecture, sequence, quadrant, Gantt, loop, state machine...)
✅ Self-contained HTML + SVG — no build step, no JavaScript, no external image dependencies

Every diagram inherits your brand tokens automatically. Your homepage background becomes the diagram paper. Your CTA color becomes the focal accent. Your body font becomes the node labels.

The repo has 21,613 stars and works with Claude Code, Codex, and Pi out of the box.

🔎 Search GitHub for "cathrynlavery/diagram-design" to see the full gallery and install instructions.

What diagram type do you fight with most — architecture, sequence, or quadrant? 👇
